scope: Selected Channel versus antenna azimuth, elevation and feed parallactic angle on the reversed two-field MeasurementSet. Two selected baselines use three channels, including one flagged on both baselines. The parallactic-angle plots test a nonzero first receptor, a right beam-waveguide mount and dual-correlation selection. The feed parallactic angle cases use CASA's ant-parang and ant-parallacticangle aliases.
baseline_result: The native public task refuses the unsupported antenna azimuth axis.
